fields.statement: QA with the branch's built rhiza binary (fake rex/claude, scratch root): leaf alpha failed 3 attempts (beta skipped); run resume --retry with its question unanswered gave alpha a retry round (JSON round 2 retry:true, no decision) and attempts 4-6 ran; with the builder then passing, a second retry gave round 3, the builder prompt named the retry round with no Decision, alpha passed at attempt 7, skipped beta was built and the run succeeded. In a fresh run with the question answered by Decision use-a-map before the retry, alpha got exactly one round (decision use-a-map, no retry round, no 'retry gives it' log line) and its prompt named the Decision. Problems: human run status prints 'decision  answers question' (empty) for retry rounds (internal/api/run.go:2952), and testscript build-leaf-fails.txtar still asserts the old 'unanswered retry starts nothing' and fails.
